name: TOB Notification Template
description: One row per notification event — the template-driven source of every notification's title/body/priority/deep-link, so no notification text is hardcoded in Python. Rendered with Jinja (frappe.render_template) against whatever variables the triggering event supplies. System-Manager-only; content is app configuration, not per-user data.

fields.label: Event Code
fields.description: e.g. BIBLE_READING_CONTINUE, QUIZ_RESULT_AVAILABLE, NEW_SUPPORT_TICKET — the identifier every doc_event/scheduler call passes to the engine.

fields.label: Audience
fields.description: Keeps user and admin notification audiences from ever mixing — the engine resolves recipients differently per audience.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Disabling this makes the engine skip the event entirely (no Notification Log row, no push) without removing the trigger wiring.

fields.description: Matches one toggle on TOB Notification Preference (User audience) or an admin role bucket (Admin audience).

fields.label: Deep Link Route
fields.description: An existing Flutter named route, e.g. /viewQuiz, /viewTicket, /batch — matches deepLink_routes.dart exactly. Sent as the FCM payload's 'route'.

fields.label: Deep Link Id Variable
fields.description: Which variable name (from the event's own variables dict) supplies the record id the route needs, e.g. 'quiz_id', 'ticket_id'. Leave blank for a route that takes no id.

fields.label: When This Fires
fields.description: Human-readable trigger/schedule description shown to admins (e.g. 'Hourly scan · sent during your Daily Reminder Time'). Purely informational — editing it never changes when the event actually fires; update the linked scan/trigger code for that.

fields.label: Live Status
fields.description: Working: fully wired and firing today. Needs Setup: correctly wired in code but blocked on an external step (e.g. a webhook not yet registered, a site_config key not yet set) — flip to Working once that step is done. Unverified: wired but the payload/trigger shape hasn't been confirmed against a live delivery yet.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Jinja template, e.g. "Continue your reading in {{ book }} {{ chapter }}." Rendered against the event's variables.

fields.label: Body
fields.description: Optional longer body, same Jinja rules as Title.

fields.label: Internal Note
fields.description: Not shown to the user — for whoever edits this row later to understand what triggers it and why the copy is worded this way (tone rules, etc.).
